name: Ad Honesty & Provider Contract
note: The build now carries the AdMob SDK. Consent is not optional for the five EEA languages this app ships, so the mutations below break each half of that flow separately: the request for consent, each of the three gated ad paths, and the way back into the choice.

mutations.name: the placeholder provider claims to be a real ad network
mutations.why: Every placement branches on isReal to decide whether to say "watching an ad" or "ad placeholder". A provider that lies here makes all four of them lie at once.

mutations.name: the rewarded ad is requested without checking consent
mutations.why: One deleted guard serves a personalised ad to a player who was never asked. Every other test keeps passing, which is exactly why this is checked in the source rather than left to a device run that happened once.
mutations.expectFailure: showRewarded requests an ad without checking canRequestAds

mutations.name: consent is never requested at all
mutations.why: Without requestConsentInfo the first ad goes out before anyone has been asked. In the EEA that is an advertising policy violation, not a bug.
mutations.expectFailure: init() does not ask the consent SDK

mutations.name: the way back into the consent choice is removed
mutations.why: Google requires a path back for anyone shown the form. Without it the choice is permanent from the player's side.
mutations.expectFailure: never asks whether a privacy options form exists
